summary: The three review-5 findings are resolved. No critical or major defects remain under §0’s cooperative-agent threat model. Two minor gaps remain in recovery and validation.

findings.claim: Merge reconciliation lacks a completion path when the remote advances beyond the successfully pushed head before reconciliation.
findings.evidence: Reconciliation consumes the receipt when the remote equals head and permits retry when it equals reviewed base. After an accepted push with a lost response, a subsequent legitimate merge can leave the remote at a descendant of head; neither documented condition applies.
findings.fix: Define reconciliation for subsequent remote advancement using evidence that the reviewed head was integrated, retaining pending status when inconclusive. Add an accepted-push → lost-response → subsequent-advance test.

findings.claim: The build sequence omits the newly added successful-merge smoke test.
findings.evidence: §6 step 7 still specifies staging S1–S7, while S8 tests the accepted lease-guarded push, receipt consumption, and verified merge tree. Step 8 therefore remains the first prescribed successful exercise of that route.
findings.fix: Include S8 in the staging checks before the real merge in §6 step 8.
